<thought>Search the template catalog for any templates applicable to the deprotected product SMILES without additional filtering; this will return candidate templates, from which we can identify the one that generates the provided precursor pair.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "limit": 20
}
</action_input>
